verdict.rationale: LibreChat's own materials claim secure multi-language code execution through its Code Interpreter, which implies isolated execution of risky code runs. They also list an Access Control feature and per-role/per-group configuration overrides, but none of the evidence describes container/VM sandboxing, tool allowlists, or permission modes that limit what an agent can touch. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a container/VM sandbox for code execution, documented per-agent or per-role tool policies or approval/permission modes, MCP/tool scoping controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, risky tool runs are containable — container/VM sandboxing, tool policies, or permission modes that limit what the agent can touch

citations.quote: Execute code in multiple languages securely with zero setup
including per-role and per-group overrides that take effect at login without restarting LibreChat
